video_meta.title: Who ACTUALLY Handles Pain Better: Men or Women?
video_meta.description: Science finally settles the age-old debate on pain tolerance! From testosterone to brain wiring, discover the biological reasons men and women experience pain differently. #PainTolerance #Science #Biology #MenVsWomen #FunFacts
